summary: Implemented the feature in the repository without running any code or tests, and without committing. Changes: new monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver with save, save_batch, finalize, including the overwrite=False merge) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver with save, save_batch, and a private static _create_file_basename); monai/data/nifti_writer.py default dtype changed to np.float32; monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py gained plot_2d_or_3d_image; monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py, classification_saver.py and tensorboard_handlers.py rewritten as thin adapters over the savers and plot function (classification registers an engine-accepting wrapper _finalize_on_completed). Callers updated from output_path to output_dir in tests/integration_sliding_window.py and examples/segmentation_3d/unet_evaluation_array.py and unet_evaluation_dict.py. Tests added: tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py; tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py updated to pass filename. Verification was by reading only: no lines over 120 characters, continuation alignment checked, single trailing newline per file, no circular imports. Flake8 and the tests have NOT been run. Choices made: the CSV merge also updates the in-memory cache; blank CSV rows are skipped; tensor affines are converted to numpy in NiftiSaver; RGB CHW images are not rescaled; the TensorBoard handler still calls batch_transform twice as before.
